name: JV_ACCOUNT_FILTERS_
description: This table contains the account filters within an account filter set to be used by Joint Venture Management processes.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_FILTER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture account filter.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_FILTER_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture account filter set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: The code for the segment for the account filter.

columns.name: FILTER_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: The code for the filter operator. It is based on ORA_JV_ACCT_FILTER_OPERATOR lookup codes such as ORA_JV_EQUAL, ORA_JV_NOT_EQUAL, and ORA_JV_BETWEEN.

columns.name: SEGMENT_LOW_VALUE
columns.description: The value of the account filter segment or the low value which corresponds to the account filter range.

columns.name: SEGMENT_HIGH_VALUE
columns.description: The high value which corresponds to the account filter range.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
